execute_sql.rationale: The tool can `Execute SQL queries on the sqlite database`, so it can read database contents; database contents are treated as potentially non-public data. It can also change state because the schema says `multiple statements separated by ;` and annotations say readOnly false/destructive true. The advertised text does not say the SQLite database is public, multi-writer, attacker-controlled, network-capable, or capable of host code execution, so I do not label UNTRUSTED, SINK, or HOSTEXEC.

search_objects.rationale: The tool can `Search and list database objects on the sqlite database`, which can reveal non-public database schema/object metadata. It is read-only and only searches the configured SQLite database; the advertised text does not say it contacts agent-chosen hosts, returns attacker-authored public content, writes anywhere, or executes host code.
